body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2009') -- <Visual News> Sanus Systems introduced an in-wall power and cable management system 'Elements ELM805 Power Bridge' at 2009 CES, which is designed to simplify installation of cables and wiring behind wall-mounted flat-panel TVs, as well as eliminate ground loop problems when utilizing a remote equipment room.
Once the mount is installed, power can be routed through the wall and connected between an existing home outlet and the Elements Power Bridge via an included 6-foot AC power cord.

The ELM805 also features cable routing holes to give both low-voltage and AC connections a clean, finished look. The ELM805 will be available beginning first quarter, 2009, and will be offered in black and white finishes.
